task.description:
WF-02, step 1 (rework 2 of 2: this is the last repeat; a FAIL at the third gate pass stops the run and goes to the owner) — rework the design docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md by the findings F11-F16 of the second gate pass in handoffs/E2E104-20261103-01/step-01d-code-design-validator.json (read result.findings yourself). Rework ONLY by that list; anything beyond it goes to result.issues (AP-019). Do not weaken any criterion. The answers of ORCH in decisions/0108 (О9 now extended to REQ-040) are binding.
- F11 (BLOCKING, section 11.3): the TAP texts "captured once" (for example failing.txt) hold the capturing machine's absolute path in `location:` and `stack:` lines; `npm run traces` (a step of `check`) fails on such a path, so criterion 11 is unmet. State how every such fixture is made free of absolute paths and of any machine name (for example: the fixture is generated by the test from parts at run time into the temporary folder, or the committed text is written with relative paths only), and add a test that `npm run traces` passes on the committed fixtures plus a mutant for it. Measure it yourself: run the traces command on a scratch copy containing a captured TAP file, and say what it reports.
- F12: write down, not leave to the developer: removal of the signal hook when the run ends (E2K-32 calls runAll six times in one process); a signal during listSpecs or the preflight (INTERRUPTED and the record line in all cases, as the design promises); whether the stop unregisters the spec group; what happens when a hook throws; the exit code after a second signal.
- F13: an injected spawnSpec cannot see `detached`: reword E2K-37 so it can be written; the preflight call of launchBrowser() — say with which env and `launch` option.
- F14: give tests for SIGHUP (129), the second-signal case and the 10 s cap, or remove the promise; correct M59's stated reason (measured: the spec leader and file child die to the group SIGKILL; only the browser group survives, so E2K-38 stays red).
- F15: record in section 18 that REQ-040 needs the same correction as REQ-038 (lines near 5502 and 5566).
- F16: state that the sandbox flags and the skip words stay out of kit comments too (E2K-50 and the criterion-10(d) grep scan the kit files).
After the rework the replacement table, the mutants (add mutants for new rules), the criterion → test table and the bar section must still be consistent. Write the table "what was fixed, where" in result. One agent at a time on this Mac: light trials, kill any Chrome you start by process id, remove only temp folders you made, never rm inside the project. No name of another project in any file.
acceptance_criteria: Every finding F11..F16 has a line in what was fixed / where, or an honest reason

result.summary: Reworked docs/design/REQ-104-e2e-chrome-kit.md by the findings F11-F16 of the second gate pass and nothing else. F11 (blocking) measured on a fresh clone of the tag and closed by a capture-outside-the-project plus normalization procedure and a test that applies the traces rules to the fixtures. F12-F16 written down, tested or corrected. Totals now: 13 criteria, 53 tests (40 E2K with the new E2K-39, 13 SMK), 72 mutants (new M62-M72, M59 reason corrected), 8 sub-steps, replacement table unchanged (six tests). No implementation code, no criterion weakened.

changes.where: section 1 F34 (new); section 11.3 paragraph on the tap folder rewritten (capture outside the project, normalize, check by hand, which file holds a path); section 11.1 E2K-34; section 10 rows 7 and 11; section 16 (no new mutant of its own: M-rules below)
changes.what: Measured on a fresh clone of the tag: the captured failing.txt holds the machine path in the location: and stack: lines; npm run traces reported 2 traces (exit 1 with one such line left); after removing the absolute path of the tools folder (file://<abs>/ and <abs>/) the lines are relative, traces gives 0 traces, exit 0, the criterion-11 grep gives 0. The design now says: capture to a folder outside the project, normalize by that rule, grep by hand, then copy; E2K-34 additionally reads the five tap texts and nine spec fixtures and runs hasHomePath/hasTempPath of tools/src/traces/rules.js (the rules npm run traces applies) plus plain checks (no file:, no absolute path), so a text committed without the rule turns npm test red. Mutant for it: M72 is for comments; the tap-text mutant is carried by E2K-34 itself (a fixture text with an absolute path = red); see issues I1.

changes.where: section 4.4 (addSignalHook, installHandlers, liveRegistrations, hookErrors); section 6 flow step 1 (hook added right after installHandlers, finally remove), step 5 (stop unregisters the group), new 'signal paragraph', 'Exit codes'; section 7 rows 12, 17, new 18; section 8 row Clean-up; section 11.1 E2K-32, E2K-33, E2K-51, E2K-39 (new); section 16 M62, M63, M65, M66, M67, M68, M69
changes.what: (a) runAll removes its hook in a finally; liveRegistrations() gains hooks and E2K-32/E2K-51 assert 0. (b) the hook is installed as the second statement of runAll; INTERRUPTED and the record line are written first by the hook at any moment (preflight included, test: fourth run of E2K-38); the only window is module loading before runAll. (c) Stop calls unregisterGroup after the group is gone. (d) hooks start at once, one total limit hookLimitMs (default 10000, option of the first installHandlers call), a hook error is caught and kept in hookErrors(), clean-up still runs; no separate per-hook limit. (e) exit code after a second signal is 128 + the number of the FIRST signal, and the second signal skips the wait.

changes.where: section 6 signature (spawnSpec argument object with detached, child contract, launch default and env), step 4, step 5 'The process'; section 11.1 E2K-37, E2K-32; section 1 F35; section 16 M70, M71
changes.what: (a) spawnSpec({ args, cwd, env, detached }) always gets detached: true in the argument, so E2K-37 can assert it; the fake child is an EventEmitter with pid 2147483646 (measured ESRCH, F35), a stdout carrying tap/normal.txt and a close event; a fake without a numeric pid or with an error event gives SPEC_FAILED (could not be started). (b) the preflight calls launch({ env }) with the runner's env as is; E2K-32 injects a launch that starts the stand-in and asserts the line e2e: browser=FakeChrome/1.2.3.

changes.where: section 11.1 E2K-18 (SIGHUP 129), E2K-38 (SIGINT, SIGHUP, preflight run, 8 s), E2K-39 (new: hook awaited with SIGHUP 129, 1 s limit, throwing hook, second signal, removed hook); section 10 rows 3 and 7; section 15 sub-steps 4 and 6; section 16 M59 reason, M60, M64, M65, M66
changes.what: The SIGHUP, second-signal and cap promises are kept and now have tests (E2K-18, E2K-38, E2K-39) and mutants. M59's reason corrected: with the group registered the exit clean-up SIGKILLs the spec leader and file child; the browser group (stand-in and child) and the profile folder stay, plus the missing INTERRUPTED line, so E2K-38 is red for that reason. Totals: 53 tests (40 E2K), 72 mutants.

changes.where: section 18 (new bullet before the REQ-038 bullet); section 19 О9 row
changes.what: Named the pending REQ-040: description near 5500-5503 and criterion 2 near 5566 say 'the check check ends with npm run test passes without edit'; false when REQ-040 is built; the same correction as REQ-038 (0108 О9 extended): DOC-UPDATER at step 10 or a micro-amendment by REQ-ANALYST, ORCH chooses. No change of REQ-104 code.

changes.where: section 3 (new 'Words in comments' paragraph after the file table); section 4.6 step 3; section 11 'Forbidden words' (new bullet 'Comments are text too'); E2K-25, E2K-50, criterion 11 row; section 17 Q6; section 16 M72
changes.what: The two sandbox flags and the skip words/options do not stand in any file under tools/test/e2e, the test file or the stand-in, comments included; the allowed comment wording is given; E2K-25 and E2K-50 say 'in code or in a comment'; mutant M72.

result.self_check: cd tools && npm run handoffs-check -> 'нарушений 0'; npm run traces -> 'следов 0' (2384 files, design included); npm run format:check -> 'All matched files use Prettier code style!'. Measurements (fresh clone of tag base/E2E104-20261103-01 in the session scratch folder, e2e104e, node v22.23.4): capture of fail.e2e.js with 'env -u NODE_TEST_CONTEXT node --test --test-reporter=tap' exit 1, location: and stack: hold the absolute path; 'npm run -s traces' on the clone: 'следов 2' (lines 7 and 12 of tap/fail.txt, 'путь домашнего каталога'); with a made-up home-style prefix: 'следов 2'; one such line left: 'следов 1', exit 1; after removing the absolute path of tools/ in both forms: 'следов 0', exit 0, 'npm run -s traces | grep -c -E tools/test/e2e|tools/test/fixtures/e2e' -> 0, 'npx prettier --check test/fixtures/e2e' passes, hasHomePath per line and hasTempPath per text false for both captured texts; process.kill(-pid,0) for 2147483646, 4194305, 99999 -> ESRCH (Darwin). Design greps: three backticks 0; no user path, no other project name; E2K ids 01..61 = 40 tests, counts in sections 0, 3, 11, 16 agree (53 tests, 72 mutants). Not measured: the Linux value of the pid test (F35), the Windows path syntax of the normalization (rule is stated as 'whatever absolute prefix the text holds').

issues.text: F11: no separate mutant row for 'tap text committed with a machine path'; the oracle is E2K-34 itself (a fixture with a path = red) and the check step 'npm run traces'. If TEST-DESIGN-VALIDATOR wants a numbered mutant, M73 'a captured text with an absolute path is committed' -> E2K-34 and npm run traces can be added without a design change.

For ORCH: F15 asks a choice at step 10 - correct the REQ-040 sentence by DOC-UPDATER (as an outdated fact) or by a micro-amendment of WF-01 through REQ-ANALYST because REQ-040 is pending. The design only names the lines (section 18, section 19 О9).

Beyond the list (AP-019) nothing was changed except two consequences of the listed rules: (1) a start failure of the spec process (no numeric pid or an error event) now gives SPEC_FAILED with a test row in E2K-37, because the fake child of F13 needs a defined contract; (2) installHandlers takes the option hookLimitMs so that E2K-39 can run with a 1 s limit instead of waiting 10 s. Both can be dropped by ORCH if judged extra, but then F13(a) and F14 lose their test.
Not repeated: the real-Chrome facts F12-F28 (unchanged); no Chrome was started in this rework; the Windows PC path syntax and Linux pid behaviour stay unmeasured and are settled by criterion 10.

result.prototype: Session scratch folder, e2e104e: a clone of the tag with two spec files, their captured TAP texts and the normalization script; removed at the end.
